name: Awake
overview: The Bible calls believers to be spiritually awake, urging them to put on strength and vigilance as seen in Isaiah's exhortations to awake and clothe Zion with holiness. The New Testament echoes this call, emphasizing watchfulness and prayer in anticipation of Christ's return, reminding believers that the time for awakening is urgent because salvation is nearer than ever. This awakening involves arising from spiritual sleep to receive the light of Christ, enabling believers to stand ready before the Son of Man.
